examples.text: 人是从语言里学会语法，而非从语法里学会语言的。
examples.englishTranslation: One learns grammar from language, not language from grammar.

examples.text: 在许多突厥语族的语言中，“阿拉木图”有“苹果之父”的意思。
examples.englishTranslation: "Almaty" means "The Father of Apples" in many Turkic languages.

englishTranslation: so, actually, as it turns out

examples.text: 你一用完了这本书，就把它放回原来找到的地方。
examples.englishTranslation: When you're done with the book, put it back where you found it.

examples.text: 错误和谎言我都可以忍受，但我不能原谅幽默感的彻底丧失。
examples.englishTranslation: Mistakes and lying can be worked through, but I cannot stand a complete lack of humour.

examples.text: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。
examples.englishTranslation: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.

englishTranslation: to make consistent and whole (the narrative of a dream or a lie)

examples.text: 你有没有想过跟朋友的前男友约会？
examples.englishTranslation: Would you ever consider dating your best friend's ex-boyfriend?

examples.text: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。
examples.englishTranslation: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.

examples.text: 抱歉，请允许我指出上文中的三个错误。
examples.englishTranslation: Excuse me; allow me to point out three errors in the above article.

examples.text: 报纸、杂志和新闻广播讲述着世界上正在发生的事。
examples.englishTranslation: Newspapers, magazines, and newscasts tell what is going on in the world.

englishTranslation: we or us (including both the speaker and the person(s) spoken to)
(dialect) (in a coaxing or familiar way) you

examples.text: 普京对胡锦涛说：“咱们必须帮吉尔吉斯斯坦”……不过那只是在我梦里的情形。
examples.englishTranslation: "We need to help Kyrgyzstan," said Putin to Hu Jintao... in my dream.

englishTranslation: temporary; provisional; for the time being

examples.text: 对不起，您拨打的用户暂时无法接通。
examples.englishTranslation: We're sorry. The number you have dialed is currently unavailable.

examples.text: 有人说，玛丽·安托瓦内特对法国大革命有着不可推卸的责任。
examples.englishTranslation: They say that Marie Antoinette was responsible for the French Revolution.

examples.text: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。
examples.englishTranslation: As time went on, rules were added to the game to make it safer.

examples.text: 这家公司去年获得显著的营业额增长。
examples.englishTranslation: This company achieved a remarkable increase in turnover last year.

examples.text: 我男朋友还没有去过长城。
examples.englishTranslation: My boyfriend still hasn't been to the Great Wall.

examples.text: 长江是亚洲的最长江，6380公里。
examples.englishTranslation: The Yangtze at 6,380 km is Asia's longest river.

englishTranslation: to invite applications for a job

examples.text: 计划是在下月底之前招聘5名Java工程师。
examples.englishTranslation: The plan is to recruit 5 Java engineers before the end of next month.

examples.text: 富士山可能是世界上最著名的山峰之一。
examples.englishTranslation: Mt Fuji is probably one of the world's most famous mountains.

examples.text: 每一个人都应该知法懂法，但是真正能做到的人却很少。
examples.englishTranslation: Everybody is supposed to know the law, but few people really do.

examples.text: 汤姆花了大半早晨整理他的办公室。
examples.englishTranslation: Tom spent most of the morning straightening up his office.

examples.text: 她把头发拍整齐了。
examples.englishTranslation: She patted her hair into place.

examples.text: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。
examples.englishTranslation: Don't eat too much and disrupt the stomach's normal digestion process.

examples.text: 公共汽车的停车站正好坐落在我的住所前面。
examples.englishTranslation: The bus stop is located right outside where I live.

examples.text: 不正确的命题听起来可能符合逻辑。
examples.englishTranslation: An argument may be logically sound without being true.

examples.text: 这个典礼有多正式?
examples.englishTranslation: How formal is this ceremony?

examples.text: 你能不能提供他那天晚上没在家的证明？
examples.englishTranslation: Can you produce any evidence that he was not at home that night?

examples.text: 不管你认不认识他，你都应该支持他的想法。
examples.englishTranslation: Whether you know him or not, you have to support his opinion.

examples.text: 比起父母的说教，小孩子会从父母的品格中习得更多知识。
examples.englishTranslation: Children learn more from what you are than what you teach.

englishTranslation: direct (opposite: indirect 間接|间接[jian4 jie1])
to merit; to deserve; to be worth (doing sth)

examples.text: 人们不愿意把钱借给那些不值得信任的人。
examples.englishTranslation: People are not willing to lend money to people who aren't trustworthy.

examples.text: 我喜欢画油画，但是我不想拿它做我的终身职业。
examples.englishTranslation: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.

examples.text: 这些植物太小了，我觉得它们长不大。
examples.englishTranslation: These plants are too small. I don't think that they'll grow.

englishTranslation: to have no other option but to ...; to have to; to be forced to

examples.text: 他无能为力，只好放弃计划
examples.englishTranslation: He could do nothing but give up his plan against his will.

examples.text: 别人可以随便怎么想，只要他们的想法与我的相同。
examples.englishTranslation: Other people can think what they want, as long as they think like I do.

examples.text: 汤姆跟玛丽来这公园至少十二次。
examples.englishTranslation: Tom has been to this park with Mary at least a dozen times.

examples.text: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。
examples.englishTranslation: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.

examples.text: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。
examples.englishTranslation: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.

examples.text: 如果我去中国的话，是为了尽可能多地说中文。
examples.englishTranslation: If I go to China, it'd be to speak Chinese as much as possible.

examples.text: 我不能抓到他演讲的重点。
examples.englishTranslation: I couldn't get the point of his speech.

englishTranslation: to attach importance to sth; to value

examples.text: 父母很重视孩子的教育。
examples.englishTranslation: The parents value their children's education.

examples.text: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。
examples.englishTranslation: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.

examples.text: 周围太吵了，我无法专心学习。
examples.englishTranslation: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.

examples.text: 在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。
examples.englishTranslation: With her help, my French improved little by little.

englishTranslation: to do sth of one's own accord
opposite: passive 被動|被动[bei4 dong4]

examples.text: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。
examples.englishTranslation: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.

examples.text: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
examples.englishTranslation: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.

examples.text: 或许我是第一个给你祝贺的人。
examples.englishTranslation: May I be the first to offer my congratulations.

englishTranslation: specialized; dedicated (to a particular field or purpose)
(of institutions, personnel etc) designated or assigned for a specific task; special

examples.text: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。
examples.englishTranslation: This is a store that caters specially to students.

examples.text: “一家之主”是一份专业工作、事业和使命。
examples.englishTranslation: The "family manager" is a profession, occupation, vocation.

examples.text: 不要把精确和准确搞错。
examples.englishTranslation: Let's not mistake precision for accuracy.

examples.text: “我们的火车九点就开了。”“别担心。我们会准时到的。”
examples.englishTranslation: "Our train leaves at 9:00." "Don't worry. We'll make it."

englishTranslation: to be careful; to look out

examples.text: 吃药之前一定要仔细看说明书。
examples.englishTranslation: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.

examples.text: 自然从不会欺骗我们，骗我们的永远是我们自己。
examples.englishTranslation: Nature never deceives us; it is always we who deceive ourselves.

examples.text: 他的论文总结了电脑，人造卫星和火箭三个的新成就。
examples.englishTranslation: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.

examples.text: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
examples.englishTranslation: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

examples.text: 这个组织跟任何政党没有联系。
examples.englishTranslation: The organization is not connected with any political parties.

englishTranslation: had better ...; it would be best to ...

examples.text: Tom 是我曾经的朋友里最好的，但是他依然让我失望了。
examples.englishTranslation: Tom was the best friend I've ever known, but he also disappointed me.

examples.text: 这大概是我最后一次环球旅行，在此之后，我就不再环游世界了。
examples.englishTranslation: This is probably my very last world trip. After this one, I'm done.

examples.text: 他总是很尊重妻子的意见。
examples.englishTranslation: He is always very respectful of his wife's opinions.

examples.text: 《围城》的作者是钱钟书。
examples.englishTranslation: The author of Fortress Besieged is Qian Zhongshu.

englishTranslation: (archaic) suffix used in a respectful form of address (e.g. 師座|师座[shi1 zuo4])
classifier for large immovable objects such as buildings, mountains, bridges etc

examples.text: 不管他是上学还是做生意，我不会反对。
examples.englishTranslation: Whether he studies or goes into business, I won't stop him.
